FROM course_session WHERE course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY FIELD(day_of_week, 'MON', 'TUE', 'WED', 'THU', 'FRI', 'SAT', 'SUN'), start_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_session ( course_id, type, day_of_week, start_time, end_time, location ) VALUES ( #{courseId}, #{type}, #{dayOfWeek}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{location} )
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.course_id AS courseId, c.course_code AS courseCode, s.type, s.day_of_week AS dayOfWeek, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, s.location FROM course_session s INNER JOIN enrollment e ON e.course_id = s.course_id AND e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.active = 1 INNER JOIN course c ON c.id = s.course_id INNER JOIN user u ON u.id = #{userId} WHERE c.tenant_id = u.tenant_id ORDER BY s.course_id, s.id
